en.headline: DSS schools expo draws over 15,000 as council publishes dormitory code
en.dek: The annual Direct Subsidy Scheme schools expo at Kowloon Shangri-La drew 20 per cent more visitors than last year, while three operators have applied for a voluntary white list under a new operating code.
body: The Hong Kong Direct Subsidy Scheme Schools Council said its expo for the 2027 intake, held yesterday at the Kowloon Shangri-La Hotel, attracted more than 15,000 visitors across the day, a 20 per cent rise on the previous year. Some participating schools reported fewer parents from the Top Talent Pass Scheme among those attending.

On the same day the council published a voluntary Student Accommodation Facilities Operating Code of Practice covering infrastructure, meals and cultural activities. Operators must list all charges clearly with no hidden fees, provide two meals on school days and three on non-school days, organise regular social and local culture events, and supply legal proof that any unit alterations meet statutory requirements.

Council vice-chairman Chan Dik-on said three operators had already applied for the temporary white list. The list will be sent to DSS schools for recommendation to non-local students and parents and placed on the Study in Hong Kong website. The council will inspect facilities regularly and remove any that fall short after checks. The Education Bureau said earlier that 14 DSS schools had admitted 170 non-local students on student visas this academic year.

zh.headline: 直資校聯展逾1.5萬人次入場 議會公布宿舍營運守則
zh.dek: 香港直資學校聯展昨日在九龍香格里拉舉行，全日逾1.5萬人次，較去年增兩成；直資議會同日公布宿舍營運守則，白名單暫收3個申請。
body: 香港直接資助學校議會表示，為2027年度收生而設的直資學校聯展昨日在九龍香格里拉酒店舉行，全日入場人次逾1.5萬，較去年增加兩成。部分參展學校指到場的高才通家長有所減少。
議會同日公布自願性質的《學生住宿設施營運實務守則》，涵蓋基礎設施、膳食安排及文化活動等。營辦方須清晰列明各項收費，不得有隱藏收費；上課日為宿生提供早晚兩餐，非上課日提供三餐；須定期舉辦聯誼及本地文化體驗活動；並須提交法律證明，證明單位改動符合法例要求。
議會副主席陳狄安表示，目前白名單暫收到3個申請。名單將派發予各直資學校，供校方推薦給非本地生及家長，並上載至「留學香港：直資學校」網站。議會會定期派員檢查，若表現欠佳或違反守則，經核實後會除名並通知各校。教育局較早時表示，今學年14間直資學校共錄取170名持學生簽證的非本地生。
